name: arithmetic and interpolation
source:
Let count be 2.
Say "count={count}; total={count plus 3}.".

name: branch and loop
source:
Let total be 0.
Repeat 3 times:
    Set total to total plus the current repetition number.
End repeat.
If total is equal to 6:
    Say "ok".
Otherwise:
    Say "bad".
End if.

name: function and collection
source:
To double with value:
    Give back value times 2.
End function.
Let values be [2, 4].
Say double(values[1]).

name: dictionary literal and slice
source:
Let profile be {"answer": 42}.
Let values be [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].
Say profile["answer"].
Say values[1:4:2].
Say values[::-1].

name: unicode text slicing
source: Say "héllo"[1:3].

name: class constructor fields and methods
source:
Create a class called Animal:
    When creating an Animal with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To speak:
        Say "{this.name} makes a sound.".
    End function.
    To greet with greeting:
        Say "{greeting}, {this.name}.".
    End function.
End class.
Let dog be a new Animal with "Max".
Tell dog to speak.
Tell dog to greet with "Hello".
output:
Max makes a sound.
Hello, Max.

name: class inheritance and overriding
source:
Create a class called Animal:
    When creating an Animal with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To speak:
        Say "{this.name} makes a sound.".
    End function.
End class.
Create a class called Dog based on Animal:
    To speak:
        Say "Woof, {this.name}!".
    End function.
    To greet with prefix:
        Say "{prefix} {this.name}.".
    End function.
End class.
Let pet be a new Dog with "Rex".
Set pet.name to "Rexy".
Tell pet to speak.
Tell pet to greet with "Pet:".

name: class type inspection
source:
Create a class called Box:
End class.
Let box be a new Box.
Say type_of(Box).
Say type_of(box).

name: local module import and cache
source:
Use the module "math_helpers.tell" as helpers.
Use the module "math_helpers.tell" as helper_copy.
Say helpers.triple(7).
Say helper_copy.triple(3).

name: expression precedence and short circuit
source:
If 2 plus 3 times 4 is equal to 14:
    Say "precedence ok".
End if.
If false and (1 divided by 0 is equal to 0):
    Say "bad and".
Otherwise:
    Say "and short-circuited".
End if.
If true or (1 divided by 0 is equal to 0):
    Say "or short-circuited".
End if.
If 2 to the power of 3 to the power of 2 is equal to 512:
    Say "right associative".
End if.
If 1.5e2 plus 1e1 is equal to 160:
    Say "scientific notation".
End if.
output:
precedence ok
and short-circuited
or short-circuited
right associative
scientific notation

name: operator phrases preserve quoted text
source:
Say "plus and is equal to remain text".
If 4 IS AT LEAST 4:
    Say "case-insensitive phrase".
End if.
If 2 is not in [1, 3]:
    Say "not a member".
End if.
If 2 is in [1, 2, 3]:
    Say "member".
End if.
output:
plus and is equal to remain text
case-insensitive phrase
not a member
member

name: unicode identifiers and parameters
source:
Let café be 7.
To double with valeur:
    Give back valeur times 2.
End function.
Let résumé be double(café).
Say résumé.

name: named function arguments
source:
To greet with person and greeting:
    Give back "{greeting}, {person}!".
End function.
Say greet(person="Ada", greeting="Hello").
Say greet("Grace", greeting="Welcome").

name: named constructor and method arguments
source:
Create a class called Speaker:
    When creating a Speaker with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To greet with greeting:
        Say "{greeting}, {this.name}!".
    End function.
End class.
Let speaker be Speaker(name="Ada").
Tell speaker to greet with "Hello".
Say speaker.greet(greeting="Welcome").

name: portable scalar rendering
source:
Say nothing.
Say true.
Say false.

name: portable division error
source: Say 10 divided by 0.

name: constants and runtime type annotations
source:
Let constant greeting as text be "Hello".
Let visits as number be 2.
Set visits to visits plus 1.
Say greeting.
Say visits.

name: class annotations accept derived instances
source:
Create a class called Parent:
End class.
Create a class called Child based on Parent:
End class.
Let value as Parent be new Child.
Say type_of(value).

name: typed assignment rejects incompatible value
source:
Let age as number be 21.
Set age to "old".

name: constant assignment is rejected
source:
Let constant answer be 42.
Set answer to 43.

name: unknown type annotation is rejected
source: Let score as imaginary_type be 10.

name: portable numeric types and nested collection rendering
source:
Say type_of(4).
Say [true, nothing, 3.0].
Say {"flag": true, "count": 3.0}.

name: statement delimiters inside strings and nested expressions
source:
Let phrase be "be and to remain text".
Set phrase to "to and be remain text".
Say phrase.
To echo with first and second:
    Give back first.
End function.
Say echo("left and middle", "right").
output:
to and be remain text
left and middle

name: otherwise-if chain
source:
Let choice be 2.
If choice is equal to 1:
    Say "one".
Otherwise if choice is equal to 2:
    Say "two".
Otherwise if choice is equal to 3:
    Say "three".
Otherwise:
    Say "other".
End if.

name: Check that assertion passes
source:
Check that 2 plus 2 is equal to 4.
Say "assertion passed".

name: Check that assertion fails
source: Check that false.
